title: Little Black - Black Mountain Gliderport
specs: Three launches at altitudes 1170 ft, 1400 ft, and 1650 ft
Landing zone altitude 750 ft with easy open LZ
Site offers challenging technical thermal and ridge soaring
Best flying season fall through spring; summer can be turbulent
Helmets and reserve parachutes are required equipment
Helmets required while ground handling, kiting, or using training hill
All participants must be current USHPA members with signed waiver
Comply with FAA rules and guidelines for setup, launch, flight, and landing
blurb: Little Black is a small mountain site in Rancho Penasquitos with soaring conditions from late fall through spring. It offers challenging technical thermal and ridge soaring with multiple launches and an easy open landing zone. The site requires USHPA membership and adherence to safety and city park regulations.
extraNote: No commercial activity without a San Diego Parks & Rec permit · Park gate may be locked after heavy rain; park across street if so · Do not park at the gate if closed to allow emergency vehicle access · Land only in designated landing zone; no landing near water storage property · Parking lot about 1/4 mile east of Black Mountain Rd and Carmel Valley Rd intersection; launches reached by hiking the Glider Point trail. · Late fall through spring; summer can be turbulent and mid day flying not recommended
